title: OPAL Multiplex Immunofluorescence Protocol for 4-Plex Staining
author: Franz Zemp
materials: Rehydration. Rehydrate sections through a graded ethanol series:
1X AR6 buffer for GPNMB and CD31
1X AR9 buffer for CD155 and CD112

Image Analysis. Import scanned images into HALO software (Indica Labs, v4.0.5107.407) for visualization, spectral unmixing, and quantitative analysis of marker expression, co-localization, and cellular phenotyping.

steps.title: Prepare Tissue Sections
steps.instruction: Cut FFPE tissue samples into 5 µm thick sections and mount them onto charged slides.

steps.title: Deparaffinize Slides
steps.instruction: Remove paraffin from the tissue sections using heat and solvent.

substeps.instruction: Perform three washes in xylene, 5 minutes each

steps.title: Perform Heat-Induced Antigen Retrieval (HIER)
steps.instruction: Retrieve antigens using a pressure cooker and appropriate buffer.

substeps.instruction: Perform antigen retrieval in a pressure cooker for 22 minutes
Allow slides to cool to room temperature in the buffer

steps.title: Block Non-Specific Binding
steps.instruction: Apply Protein Block (Agilent, X090930-2) to the sections to prevent non-specific binding.

substeps.instruction: Apply 200 µL of Protein Block to each section
Incubate for 30 minutes at room temperature
Gently remove excess blocking solution without rinsing

steps.title: Perform Multiplex Immunofluorescence Staining
steps.instruction: Execute sequential staining using the Opal 6-Plex Manual Detection Kit (Akoya Biosciences), including stripping and washing steps between each antibody cycle as recommended by the kit protocol.

substeps.instruction: Stain CD155: Incubate primary antibody (1:100) overnight at 4°C, paired with Opal 520 (1:200)
Stain GPNMB: Incubate primary antibody (1:200) 1 hour at room temperature, paired with Opal 570 (1:200)
Stain CD31: Incubate primary antibody (1:100) overnight at 4°C, paired with Opal 690 (1:200)
Stain CD112: Incubate primary antibody (1:200) overnight at 4°C, paired with Opal 780 (1:25)

steps.title: Scan Stained Slides
steps.instruction: Scan the processed slides using the Akoya Vectra Polaris at 20× resolution.
